doc:
# Boundary CFT — Defects

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “boundary CFT holographic dual”).

claims.name: holographic_description_alternate_boundary_conditions
claims.statement: In the 3D holographic description, alternate boundary conditions correspond to a modified $ {\tilde{\mathrm{CFT}}}_3 $ obtained by Chern-Simons gauging of the standard-boundary-condition CFT$_{3}$ dual.

sources.title: AdS Asymptotic Symmetries from CFT Mirrors

claims.name: holographic_dual_boundary_conformal_field
claims.statement: The holographic dual of a boundary conformal field theory is obtained by generalizing AdS/CFT to AdS/BCFT.

sources.title: Entanglement Entropy from a Holographic Viewpoint

claims.name: observations_final_vacuum_organized_into
claims.statement: Observations in the final vacuum are organized into a holographic dual Euclidean 2D CFT living on the asymptotic boundary.

sources.title: Census Taking in the Hat: FRW/CFT Duality

claims.name: holographic_inflation_scenario_models_dual
claims.statement: In the holographic inflation scenario, these models are dual to a deformed CFT boundary theory with $D$ mutually uncorrelated deformation operators.

claims.name: holographic_cft_double_excitation_dual
claims.statement: In holographic CFT, a double excitation is dual to anti-de Sitter space with two massive particles injected from the boundary.

sources.title: Entanglement Entropy after Double-Excitation as Interaction Measure

claims.name: bulk_dual_overline_deformed_holographic
claims.statement: A bulk dual of a $T\overline{T}$-deformed holographic CFT is a gravitational system with a finite-area cutoff boundary.

claims.name: holographic_dual_picture_coordinatetransformed_boundary
claims.statement: The holographic dual picture of coordinate-transformed boundary metrics describes a CFT at a temperature different from that of the horizon.

sources.title: Entropy of Thermal CFTs on Curved Backgrounds

claims.name: holographic_bulk_dual_action_euclidean
claims.statement: A holographic bulk dual action in Euclidean AdS space can be constructed from first principles for a Euclidean CFT on the boundary.

sources.title: Mapping from Exact RG to Holographic RG in Flat Space

claims.name: entire_physics_should_ultimately_dual
claims.statement: The entire physics on $H$ should ultimately be dual to a $2+1$ dimensional CFT on $\partial Y$, reducing the holographic dual of the global bulk space-time to a CFT on $Y$ with boundary dynamics at $\partial Y$.

sources.title: Holographic Domains of Anti-de Sitter Space

claims.name: different_boundarycondition_choices_lead_physically
claims.statement: Different boundary-condition choices lead to physically distinct holographic scenarios, and the dual CFT may contain an additional scalar field with or without background charge.

sources.title: Conformal Chern-Simons holography - lock, stock and barrel

claims.name: adding_relevant_doubletrace_deformation_int
claims.statement: Adding a relevant double-trace deformation $f \int O^{2}$ to a holographic CFT action is dual to imposing mixed Neumann/Dirichlet boundary conditions for the field dual to $O$ in AdS.

sources.title: Mixed boundary conditions and Double-trace like deformations in Celestial holography and Wedge-like holography

claims.name: ads_gravity_coupled_ds_endoftheworld
claims.statement: AdS$_3$ gravity coupled to dS$_2$ end-of-the-world branes is dual to a unitary holographic CFT$_2$ with non-unitary conformal boundary conditions.

sources.title: Monitoring a de Sitter universe through an anti-de Sitter window

claims.name: holographic_dual_bar_deformation_cft
claims.statement: The holographic dual of a $J\bar T$ deformation of a 2D CFT is AdS$_3$ with modified boundary conditions mixing the metric and Chern-Simons gauge field.

sources.title: The holographic interpretation of $J \bar T$-deformed CFTs

claims.name: context_relating_ads_cft_quantum
claims.statement: In the context of relating AdS/CFT to quantum information theory, we propose a holographic dual of Fisher information metric for mixed states in the boundary field theory.

sources.title: Connecting Fisher information to bulk entanglement in holography

claims.name: action_dual_theory_boundary_exactly
claims.statement: The action of the dual theory on the boundary t=0 is exactly the holographic dual of conformally coupled scalars on d+1 dimensional (Euclidean anti) de Sitter space obtained in (A)dS/CFT correspondence.

sources.title: dS/CFT Correspondence from a Holographic Description of Massless Scalar Fields in Minkowski Space-Time

claims.name: rindler_static_de_sitter_frw
claims.statement: For Rindler, static de Sitter, and FRW boundary metrics, the holographic stress-energy tensor of the dual CFT is computed and has the correct form including conformal anomaly effects.

claims.name: check_quantitatively_whether_holographic_bound
claims.statement: To check quantitatively whether the holographic bound manifests itself in the dual CFT, one must compute the CFT's number of degrees of freedom, $N$, which must not exceed the boundary area, $A$, in ten-dimensional Planck units.

claims.name: amplitude_large_deformations_conformal_boundary
claims.statement: The amplitude of large deformations of the conformal boundary geometry is highly suppressed in the holographic measure because the dual CFT action includes a conformal coupling term $R\phi^{2}$.

sources.title: A Smooth Exit from Eternal Inflation?
